
DESCRIPTION
Enable continuous integration

USAGE
  one ci enable [project] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one ci enable
  one ci enable web
  one ci enable web --provider ci/github-actions

TIPS
Generates continuous-integration configuration for one project, or every project when no project is provided.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  -p, --project <value>    Select a project by name or workspace-relative path (legacy/automation)
  --provider <value>       Continuous-integration provider ID (currently ci/github-actions)
